# Color-Mint — Perceptual Color Palette & Design Suite

> Color-Mint is a high-performance, client-side perceptual color engineering platform built on the OKLCH color space. It provides professional color harmonies, WCAG 2.1 & APCA contrast verification, procedural Bézier mesh gradients, and real-time color blindness deficiency simulation for digital product designers and frontend engineers.

- **Website**: https://color-mint.sarthakranjanhota.site
- **Author & Creator**: Sarthak Ranjan Hota (https://sarthakranjanhota.site)
- **Primary Color Space**: OKLCH (Perceptually Uniform Lightness, Chroma, Hue)
- **Licensing & Access**: Free, 100% Client-Side, No Login Required

---

## Core Capabilities & Tools

### 1. OKLCH Perceptual Palette Generator (`/`)
- Generates harmonious color systems utilizing the OKLCH cylindrical coordinate model.
- Prevents perceptual lightness jumps that occur in legacy sRGB / HSL models.
- Supports 9 algorithmic harmonies: Monochromatic, Complementary, Analogous, Triadic, Tetradic, Split Complementary, Square, Tonal, and Freeform.
- Instant spacebar generation, column locking, shade exploration (100–900 tints), and zero-latency Base62 URL sharing.

### 2. WCAG 2.1 & APCA Color Contrast Checker (`/contrast`)
- Real-time contrast evaluation calculating relative luminance ratios.
- Tests against WCAG 2.1 Level AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) and Level AAA (7:1 for normal text, 4.5:1 for large text).
- Supports APCA (Accessible Perceptual Contrast Algorithm) lightness difference metrics for modern display accessibility.

### 3. Procedural Bézier & Mesh Gradient Studio (`/gradients`)
- Renders non-linear color transitions using Bézier curves and cellular noise (Voronoi, Worley, Domain Warping).
- Eliminates the "gray dead zone" (muddy desaturated midpoints) standard linear interpolation produces in sRGB.
- Exports pure cross-browser CSS rules (`linear-gradient`, `-webkit-`, `-moz-`, IE filter fallbacks) and high-resolution PNGs across multiple aspect ratios (16:9, 1:1, 4:3, 9:16).

### 4. Interactive UI Token Visualizer (`/visualizer`)
- Real-time simulation of generated palettes applied across realistic digital product interfaces:
  - SaaS Analytics Dashboard with charts, KPI cards, and data tables.
  - Mobile App Viewport with cards, bottom bars, and status indicators.
  - Modern Marketing Landing Page with hero typography and call-to-actions.
  - Design System Component Kit (Buttons, Badges, Modals, Forms).

### 5. OKLCH Image Palette Extractor (`/image-picker`)
- Extracts dominant and accent color swatches directly from uploaded user imagery.
- Automatically maps pixel distributions into OKLCH space to identify harmonic clusters.

### 6. Curated Palettes Explorer (`/explore`)
- Directory of 240+ pre-calculated, accessible color systems tagged by mood, theme, and industry (e.g., Cyberpunk, Sunset, Corporate, Pastel, Earthy, Minimal).

---
